koch-biomax-hepa-9999-23-375x23-375x11-5.seoTitle: Koch BioMAX HEPA 99.99% Filter | PFS Filters
koch-biomax-hepa-9999-23-375x23-375x11-5.seoDescription: Shop Koch BioMAX HEPA 99.99%, 23.375 × 23.375 × 11.5 in., with an 18-gauge galvanized DTF frame and polyurethane foam sealant.

sections.heading: BioMAX HEPA 99.99%
paragraphs: Koch BioMAX HEPA filters are manufactured for high-efficiency commercial and industrial air-filtration systems. Koch identifies hospitals, clean rooms, pharmaceutical plants, and other systems where clean air protects people, processes, and equipment as common product-family applications.

The configured item is a 99.99% filter with actual dimensions of 23.375 × 23.375 × 11.5 inches, a double-turned-flange 18-gauge galvanized-steel frame, polyurethane foam sealant, and one filter per carton.

sections.heading: Construction described by Koch
bullets: High-efficiency media produced from submicron glass fibers formed into a water-resistant, high-density paper mat.
Precision corrugated aluminum separators maintain pleat spacing and airflow through the media pack.
The media pack is sealed to the cell-side frame with a polyurethane foam bond.
Koch literature lists a downstream neoprene gasket as the standard BioMAX arrangement; confirm the gasket arrangement required by your housing before ordering.

sections.heading: Supplied suggested specification
paragraphs: The supplied BioMAX specification calls for a minimum overall efficiency of 99.99% PAO on 0.3 micrometer particles. It describes ultrafine fiberglass media formed into a high-density, water-repellent paper; pleated construction; adhesive-bead pleat spacing; a sealed media pack; UL classification; and a label recording manufacturer, airflow direction, penetration, initial resistance, and test airflow capacity.

Important item-specific note: the generic supplied specification references 26-gauge galvanized cell sides, while the requested PFS-HBM232311 configuration is listed as 18-gauge galvanized DTF. This product page uses the requested 18-gauge item configuration. Confirm any project specification or submittal requirement before purchase.

sections.heading: Ordering check
paragraphs: Confirm the installed filter’s actual dimensions, airflow direction, frame style, gasket arrangement, efficiency requirement, and system airflow before ordering. Contact PFS Filters if the housing or required construction is uncertain.

koch-spraystop-stk10-61x90-roll.seoTitle: Koch SprayStop STK-10 61 in × 90 ft Roll | PFS Filters
koch-spraystop-stk10-61x90-roll.seoDescription: Shop Koch SprayStop STK-10 red/purple synthetic paint-arrestor media in a 61 in × 90 ft master roll, one per carton.

sections.heading: SprayStop STK-10
paragraphs: Koch SprayStop STK-10 is a synthetic paint-arrestor medium for air-dry coating materials, including lacquers and enamels. This item is one 61-inch × 90-foot master roll per carton.

sections.heading: Media and loading
bullets: Progressive-density construction is coarse on the entering-air side and becomes finer toward the exiting-air side for full-depth loading.
Koch describes the media as vacuumable and reusable when condition and facility procedures permit.
The manufacturer states that the media contains no harmful halogens.

sections.heading: Installation
paragraphs: Install the red side upstream and the purple side downstream. Confirm the booth stage, airflow direction, holding method, and cut dimensions before installation.

sections.heading: Manufacturer performance data
bullets: Up to 96% removal efficiency in the manufacturer’s STK-10 data.
Average fractional efficiency: 79.5% at 3 microns and 96% at 5 microns and larger.

sections.heading: Ordering check
paragraphs: Confirm that STK-10 synthetic media, a 61-inch roll width, and a 90-foot roll length match the installed application. Contact PFS Filters if the existing media or booth stage is uncertain.
